# Stouls Studio

> Interior architecture studio in Paris run by Margaux Stouls. For buyers based in the United States and Canada: apartment sourcing, design, renovation management and furnishing, for a rental investment or a pied-à-terre.

- [Buy and renovate an apartment in Paris from the US or Canada | Stouls Studio, interior architect](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/): Margaux Stouls, interior architect in Paris, finds your apartment, draws the plans, runs the renovation and furnishes it while you stay in the US or Canada. Rental investment or pied-à-terre.
- [Buying an apartment in Paris from abroad: search, visits and renovation estimate | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/apartment-sourcing-paris/): Looking at apartments for sale in Paris from the US or Canada? An interior architect visits them for you and prices the renovation before you make an offer.
- [Turnkey apartment renovation in Paris, managed for owners abroad | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/paris-apartment-renovation/): Plans, building approvals, contractors, site visits and furnishing for your Paris apartment, run by interior architect Margaux Stouls and reported to you in English.
- [Pied-à-terre in Paris: buying, renovating and furnishing one from abroad | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/paris-pied-a-terre/): Your own apartment in Paris, found, renovated and furnished by an interior architect while you are at home. Arrive to a finished place.
- [Margaux Stouls, interior architect in Paris | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/about/): Margaux Stouls founded Stouls Studio in Paris in 2019. She designs and manages apartment renovations, and works with owners based in North America.
- [Paris rental investment for US and Canadian buyers: what is allowed and what to build | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/paris-rental-investment/): Short tourist lets of a second home are all but closed in Paris. What still works, the energy-rating rules, and how an interior architect sources and builds a rental apartment for you.
- [Can Americans buy an apartment in Paris? A plain guide to buying and renovating | Stouls Studio](https://renanan19.github.io/sitemargaux/guide/buying-renovating-paris-apartment/): The purchase steps, the costs on top of the price, building approvals, energy ratings, rental rules and taxes to ask your adviser about, each with its official source.
